title: ReplayConstitutionV1
description: Eight pillars of lawful machine governance. No hidden nondeterminism. No ambient time. No observer-dependent execution.

1_logical_time.description: No ambient clocks. Epoch + sequence + parent. DAG is the clock.

2_versioned_hash_constitution.description: Algorithm, encoding, canonicalization fixed in genesis. Supersession creates new version.

3_deterministic_total_order.description: Order from public data only. No gossip, arrival time, or miner preference.

4_byte_exact_signatures.description: Canonical signature form required. Malleable encodings invalid.

5_append_only_corrections.description: History immutable. Corrections are supersession receipts. Every past root reproducible.

6_pre_adversarial_replay_proof.description: Shadow mode invalid until hostile replay passes. Strangers converge or constitutional failure.

7_independent_hostile_convergence.description: H0: hidden nondeterminism exists. Burden: strangers converge without node contact.

8_genesis_determinism.description: Genesis root computable from public artifacts. No hidden entropy. No secret ceremony.
